answer.reason: The verses tell of Jacob's blessing of Ephraim above his elder brother and of Ephraim's mourning for his sons.

clauses.english: was blessed by Jacob, who set him before his elder brother Manasseh
clauses.quote: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh

clauses.english: mourned many days for his sons slain by the men of Gath
clauses.quote: Ephraim their father mourned many days

doubts: Many marked verses (the censuses, camp, borders, Levite cities, Psalm 78, and the Chronicles and Numbers lists) concern the tribe of Ephraim, not the son of Joseph, so they were left out.
GEN 41:52 and GEN 46:20 only give his birth and naming, which the summary already covers.
